description: Read an Open Label project's quality-intelligence read-model (label-error doubt with per-control coverage over the project's own ontology, annotator drift, handle-time percentiles, rework rate, QA-passed billing accruals, calibration summary) or start the QI sweeps. Requires open-label:read (read) / open-label:write (sweep). 404s while the quality_intelligence flag is off.

sweep.description: true = enqueue the label-doubt + annotator-drift sweeps instead of reading.

name: open_label_quality_intelligence
